descriptions.w3d_d18a_grid_register_region_8001f394: Registers a grid region: finds an existing region with the same centre and radius through 0x8001f30c and sets its requested flag (+24); otherwise allocates a 28-byte region through 0x8001523c (position copy at +4, radius +16, active 0 +20, requested 1 +24) and appends its pointer to the grid storage at +32, growing it through 0x80212fd4/0x802eee50/0x802134fc when full.
